Title: Rajesh's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Rajesh - 31 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Anita - 60 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Shalini - 25 years, daughter
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
4. Vinod - 35 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The forest - tall trees, thick bushes
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The forest - Day

[Rajesh stands in the forest. Anita stands near him.]

Anita: "What lovely weather!"

[Rajesh goes hunting and aims his bow at a deer.]

Anita (gently): "One more time!"

[Rajesh rides an elephant through the forest.]

Rajesh (happily): "Exactly right."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Rajesh stands in the living room. Anita and Shalini stand near him.]

Shalini: "What a nice place."

[Rajesh pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Rajesh: "Well done!"

[Rajesh sips red wine.]

Anita: "I'm ready!"

[Rajesh drinks a beer.]

Shalini (happily): "Well done!"

[Rajesh staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Rajesh: "Really?"

[Rajesh and Mother clink their glasses.]

Rajesh (softly): "What a day to remember!"
